decisions.location: Discussion - Inter-individual variability, lines 774-782; Results, lines 503-515; References, lines 1668-1693
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files were checked and do not exist (never-adjudicated work). The primary source (Learmonth et al., 2017) explicitly selects the bi-parietal left P5 anode / right P6 cathode (LA/RC) montage because it previously induced a significant overall rightward shift of visuospatial attention in both Benwell et al. (2015) and Giglia et al. (2011) (Introduction, lines 250-255), empirically tests this overall rightward shift relative to sham in the new data (Results, lines 503-515 and 748-756; t(28) = 1.31, p = 0.2, BF = 1.58), and concludes in the Discussion (lines 774-782) that in contrast to both Benwell et al. (2015) and Giglia et al. (2011), it did not succeed in replicating the overall rightward shift of spatial attention bias. Reference 33 (lines 1668-1693) provides full bibliographic identity and DOI (10.1016/j.brs.2011.01.003) for Giglia et al. (2011), which is an independent 2011 study by a distinct research group not represented by the sole shipped row 1020 (Benwell et al., 2015, 10.1016/j.cortex.2015.05.007, which matches sibling blind target 0).
